## Description

Briefly describe the change and why it's needed.

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New source type
- [ ] New destination type
- [ ] Refactor / internal improvement
- [ ] Documentation

## Testing

- [ ] `cargo build` succeeds with no warnings
- [ ] `cargo test` passes (excluding ignored Postgres tests)
- [ ] If adding a new source or destination, added unit tests

## Checklist

- [ ] Code follows existing style conventions (run `cargo fmt`)
- [ ] Updated `AGENTS.md` if the change affects architecture
- [ ] Updated `README.md` if user-facing behaviour changed
